subject: Mutual Action Plan: stitch plan + 3-phase timeline
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@lumenhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@lumenhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff and MAP alignment for Lumen integration

Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. We’re ready to move into a coordinated rollout and want to lock down a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a pragmatic timeline we can share with our stakeholders. Attached is a draft MAP (Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx) — high level, three phases: pilot, staging, production.

Top priorities from our side:
- Security checklist completion (SOC evidence + network controls)
- API contract and schema freeze
- One-week pilot with 2 internal teams (clinical triage + support)

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm milestone owners (Redwood-side) for each phase?
2) What are technical blockers you expect for our VPC/private-deploy option?
3) Proposed dates: pilot start by Oct 18, staging by Nov 8, production by Nov 29 — feasible?

I’ve included Jordan (IT) who will run network & access. Marissa — looping you for CS handoff details.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Sr. Program Manager, Lumen Health
attachments: Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff and MAP alignment for Lumen integration

Olivia — thanks for the clear agenda and the MAP file. Quick responses inline plus an initial Redwood-owned milestone roster and a proposed 3-phase timeline.

Quick answers:
- Redwood milestone owners (proposed):
  * Pilot coordination & CS contact: Marissa Cole (CS Lead)
  * Integration/engineering lead: Alex Martinez (Solutions Eng) — overall delivery owner
  * Runtime/private deploy/ops: Irene Choi (Infra Eng)
  * Security & compliance liaison: Naomi Feldman (Security PM)

- Technical blockers for VPC/private-deploy: usually network peering and customer-side firewall rules (ips/ports), and validating KMS/HSM key exchange. Irene will enumerate specific artifacts.

- Dates: Pilot window Oct 18–Oct 25 is tight but doable if we get network access and API keys by Oct 4. Staging Nov 8–Nov 15, Production go-live target Nov 29 looks reasonable.

Proposed 3-phase timeline (high level):
Phase 1 — Pilot (Oct 18 start)
  - Week 0–1: Provision sandbox, secrets exchange, initial dataset load (Customer)
  - Week 1: Pilot execution, telemetry validation, quality checks (joint)
Phase 2 — Staging (Nov 8 start)
  - Infra hardening, policy gating, performance run (Redwood + Customer)
Phase 3 — Production (Nov 29 go-live)
  - Final acceptance, SLA handover, on-call rotation

Immediate asks from Redwood to Lumen (by Oct 4):
- Network contact and firewall/ip allowlist (Jordan)
- Test user accounts + sample payloads for pilot
- Signed network/data processing addendum (if not already)

I’ll attach a short onboarding RACI and a 10-line runbook after this note. Marissa, can you take point on the CS playbook and customer-facing comms? Irene, can you prepare the integration checklist and list of exact ports/artifacts?

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: integration-checklist.pdf (coming)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@lumenhealth.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff and MAP alignment for Lumen integration

All — adding a technical integration checklist and clarifying expected customer artifacts. I’ll own the runtime/provisioning milestones.

Top technical prerequisites (what I need from Lumen by Oct 4):
- Allowlist: 3 CIDR blocks and expected egress ports (443, 8443 for streaming, 22 for secured bastion if needed)
- KMS information: whether you’ll bring your key or use Redwood-managed KMS (we support both)
- Sample payloads and max token estimate for pilot requests (so we size batchers appropriately)
- A contact for certificate exchange (Jordan or security team)

Redwood deliverables and owners (dates are target completion):
- Integration runbook draft — Irene Choi — Oct 8
- Security evidence summary (SOC snapshot + data flow diagram) — Naomi Feldman — Oct 11
- CS playbook for pilot ops — Marissa Cole — Oct 9
- Pilot telemetry dashboard (initial) — Alex Martinez — Oct 20

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Firewall rules not in place by Oct 12 -> mitigation: schedule a temporary tunnel with customer network until permanent allowlist is configured
- Risk: Schema drift during pilot -> mitigation: freeze API contract after pilot sign-off and use feature-flagged rollouts in staging

I’ll attach the integration checklist PDF to the shared Drive and drop a one-pager in the MAP workbook.

Irene
Irene Choi
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@lumenhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff and MAP alignment for Lumen integration

Alex / Team —

Appreciate the fast follow and clear owners. Jordan (cc’d) will provide the allowlist by EOD Friday (Oct 1) and will confirm whether they want to manage KMS. Our legal team will push the DPA/Network addendum back to you by next week.

We accept the proposed pilot window (Oct 18–25) contingent on the network steps. Marissa — keen to review the CS playbook draft (Oct 9).

Next steps:
- Jordan: allowlist + cert contact by Oct 1
- Jordan / Lumen IT: sample payloads and test accounts by Oct 4
- Redwood: integration runbook (Irene) and CS playbook (Marissa) per dates above

If anything changes on our side I’ll flag it here — otherwise we’re green to proceed to the prep cadence.

Thanks,
Olivia
Sr. Program Manager, Lumen Health
